about.title: WHAT WAS LEFT BEHIND?
about.p1: Humanity's greatest journeys into space left more than footprints behind. They left machines, experiments, and extraordinary stories waiting to be discovered.
about.p2: When batteries depleted, solar arrays grew heavy with Martian dust, or astronauts ascended back toward Earth, these pioneering craft did not simply vanish. Today, they remain frozen in time across two worlds — silent monuments to human curiosity, engineering courage, and the quest to understand our place in the cosmos.

legacy.title: THEIR LEGACY LIVES ON
legacy.subtitle: Although their journeys have ended, their discoveries continue to shape our understanding of the universe.
discoveries.title: SCIENTIFIC DISCOVERIES
legacy.c1.desc: From hematite "blueberries" proving ancient liquid water on Mars to laser retroreflectors measuring the Moon's orbital drift, these missions rewrote planetary science.
legacy.c2.title: UNDERSTANDING WORLDS
legacy.c2.desc: Deep-interior seismic readings and regolith core samples revealed how rocky worlds form, cool, and evolve over billions of years across the inner solar system.
legacy.c3.title: ENGINEERING PROGRESS
legacy.c3.desc: Every obstacle overcome on dusty craters and ultra-thin atmospheres advanced autonomous navigation, precision landing systems, and extraterrestrial aerodynamics.
legacy.c4.title: FUTURE EXPLORATION
legacy.c4.desc: The lessons left behind by Apollo, Opportunity, and Ingenuity directly guide Artemis lunar habitats, future Mars sample return missions, and human journeys beyond.
footer.tagline: Every Explorer Has a Story. Every Signal Leaves a Legacy.
footer.description: AFTER THE SIGNAL is an interactive digital museum and educational storytelling experience preserving the history, discoveries, and enduring legacy of inactive space exploration hardware resting on the Moon and Mars.
